# Tool Registry Entry

**EDD SOP — Appendix C — Phase 4: Deployment**

Register your deployed tool in the organizational Tool Registry. Update this record whenever the tool's status, maintainer, or version changes.

---

## Tool Identification

| Field            | Value |
|------------------|-------|
| Tool Name        |       |
| Version          |       |
| Developer        |       |
| Deployment Date  |       |

---

## Description

| Field    | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Platform | Power Apps / Power Automate / GenAI.mil / SharePoint / Excel / other (specify) |
| What the tool does | _One sentence — what it does and the problem it solves._ |
| Source repository or location | _Path, SharePoint URL, or repo link._ |

---

| Field                | Value |
|----------------------|-------|

| Access mechanism     | Direct link / shared group / per-request / open to org |

## Status

| Field              | Value |
|--------------------|-------|

| Data Sensitivity   | No PII / PII Controlled / PHI (PIA on file) / CUI |
| Next Review Date   | _SOP default: 6 months after deployment._ |
